reviews.title: 2x16gb Ram Sticks
reviews.comment:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 – Huge upgrade for AM5 systems

Upgraded from a single 16GB stick to 2×16GB DDR5 6000MHz CL30, and the difference was immediately noticeable. Enabled EXPO in BIOS and it ran at rated speeds with zero issues.

Games are smoother, fewer stutters, and overall system responsiveness is much better. This is clearly the sweet spot for Ryzen AM5 — great performance without overspending.

Build quality is solid, install was easy, and stability has been perfect so far. If you’re on AM5 and still running single-channel or slower RAM, this is 100% worth it.

Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Dadrian
